name: 53221 · Milwaukee, WI
findings: ZIP 53221 (Milwaukee) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53221 (Milwaukee) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 53221 (Milwaukee) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 46 organizations here; 11% of all organizations here have no identified type.
